title: terraform: private deployment modules - GPU node pools, IAM roles, networking, state layout
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Prepare Terraform modules used by Private deployments (VPC/on-prem installer) to support GPU node pools, explicit IAM role separation, improved networking topology templates, and a reproducible state file layout for cross-account restores. This is driven by customer requests for Dedicated/Private GPU capacity and lessons learned from recent on-prem PoCs where state layout and IAM scoping caused operational outages.

Summary of changes (high level):
- Add modules/gpu-node-pool: configurable GPU instance groups, taints/labels, autoscaling integration, GKE/AKS/eks bootstrap snippets (provider-agnostic variables).
- Add modules/iam/private-roles: least-privilege IAM role templates for node pools, control-plane access, and cross-account read-only state access.
- Update modules/networking/private-vpc: new subnet templates (management/data), optional NVA/bastion configuration, clearer route table outputs.
- State layout: introduce state-layout/README + automated backend key derivation helpers to standardize naming for environments (prod/stage/customer-id) and support partial restores.
- Integration tests, examples, and migration docs.

Checklist: [x] unit/linters pass [x] terraform fmt/validate [x] integration plan tested in staging [x] documented migration steps [ ] runtime rollout plan (follow-up with ops)

Testing and verification:
- Ran terraform plan/apply in an isolated staging account using the new gpu-node-pool module (2 node pools: gpu-preemptible and gpu-persistent). Verified node labels/taints and autoscaler behavior.
- Verified IAM roles by assuming the node role from a separate account and confirming S3/state bucket read-only access with the scoped policy.
- Networking templates validated with calico+flannel test clusters and confirmed route table configuration for management subnets.
- Added CI job to run tflint/terratest suite against a small GCP sandbox; initial run had a state backend mismatch (fixed Key derivation helper). CI now green.

Migration notes:
- Existing customers will need to migrate state keys to the new standardized layout. Provide a migration helper script and step-by-step in docs/state-layout-migration.md. Recommend a dry-run in a staging copy of the state.
- IAM role renames are additive; the module emits both legacy_role_arns and new_role_arns during the transition window to avoid downtime.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main, cut patch release for redwood-terraform modules.
- Ops to apply in staging with new backend keys and run smoke tests.
- Schedule production rollout during maintenance window; 2-week monitoring with alerts on scheduling/scale failures.

Related: ENG-4921 (private gpu capacity), OPS-212 (state restore incident).
